box_contents.name: Mini Waterproof RGB LED Tea Lights

description_blocks.text: Overview

This LED remote-controlled waterproof light offers 13 colors, 2 dynamic modes, and 4 brightness levels, perfect for 3D printed models, weddings, parties, and more. It’s waterproof for underwater use, with a long-lasting, replaceable battery that provides up to 16 hours of use. The remote control can manage multiple lights at once, making it easy to create the ideal ambiance for any occasion.
Product Features
13 Colors and 2 Modes:Adjustable fade and strobe effects to suit various scene requirements.
4 Brightness Levels: Allows you to create the perfect lighting effect.
Waterproof Design: Suitable for water-based decorations such as ponds and vases.
16-Hour Battery Life: Replaceable batteries ensure long-lasting use.
Remote Control Operation: Can control multiple lights simultaneously, with flexible adjustment of lighting effects.
User Instructions

Rotate the base of the light to open it. Remove the white circular insulation sheet and then screw the cap back on. Ensure the spring inside makes contact with the battery. The light will automatically turn on and enter gradient mode (no remote control needed). If the light doesn’t turn on, reseal the cap to ensure proper contact.

Remove the transparent piece at the bottom of the remote control and press the "OFF" button to test its functionality. Press "ON" and select the desired color/function. Press "RESET" to revert the light to red.The remote control can operate multiple lights at once, with a working range of 5-10 meters. Note that the remote control is not waterproof, so keep it away from water.

The battery lasts about 16 hours per use. If the light only shows red and doesn't respond to the remote, the two CR2032 batteries may need replacing. If the remote still doesn't control the light, consider replacing the remote's CR2025 battery. For long-term storage, it's recommended to remove the batteries or replace the insulation sheet.
Considerations
This product contains small parts and poses a choking hazard. Do not ingest. If accidentally swallowed, seek immediate medical attention. Keep out of reach of children.
There are two versions of the remote control, the two versions are shipped randomly.
The remote control is not waterproof, so keep it away from water.
The infrared remote control has a range of 5-10 meters. Please operate the LED light within this effective range.
When the remote is working normally, pressing the "OFF" button will turn the light off. Press "ON" again to restore the light to its previous mode before it was turned off.

Multiple lights can be controlled simultaneously: The remote control communicates with the light through the receiver (black dot) on the light. Ensure the light is within the effective remote range and aim directly at the light when operating.

If the light still doesn't respond after replacing the batteries: If you’ve replaced the 2*CR2032 button batteries but the remote still doesn't control the light, check and replace the remote’s battery with 1*CR2025.
If not in use for a long time: For extended periods of inactivity, it’s recommended to install the battery insulation sheet or remove the batteries to prolong their life.
Use high-quality batteries to ensure proper functioning of the device.
